permissions.limitedAccess: Use a folder you can already access.
permissions.reason: Choose where finished downloads are saved.
permissions.steps: Open Eucrante and choose a destination folder in Settings. Use the system folder picker.
permissions.title: Save location

permissions.limitedAccess: Follow download progress in Eucrante without notifications.
permissions.reason: Optional alerts when a download finishes.
permissions.steps: Enable completion notifications in Eucrante. Approve its own macOS prompt, or adjust Eucrante in Notifications settings.
permissions.title: Download notifications

permissions.limitedAccess: Save audio to a folder and import it yourself.
permissions.reason: Optional permission to send a finished audio file to Music.
permissions.steps: Choose Import to Music for a finished file in Eucrante. Approve the prompt for Eucrante controlling Music.
permissions.title: Import to Music
